---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea for this project
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

**Is your feature request related to a problem? / 解决了什么痛点**
A clear and concise description of what the problem is.

**Describe the solution you'd like / 期望的方案**
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

**Describe alternatives you've considered / 考虑过的替代方案**

**Which extension point does this touch? / 涉及哪个扩展点**
- [ ] 规则(自定义敏感类别) / Custom rules
- [ ] 词表 / Word lists (v0.2)
- [ ] Agent 接入 / New agent integration
- [ ] 文档格式 / Document formats (v0.2)
- [ ] 其他 / Other

**Privacy impact / 隐私影响**
Does this feature change what data is read, stored, or sent anywhere?
(For maintainers' triage: any privacy-affecting feature needs a data-flow note.)
